entry.title: GKE Fleet Hub Lets You Grant Kubernetes Admin to Email Addresses That Don't Exist
entry.content:
GKE Fleet Hub Lets You Grant Kubernetes Admin to Email Addresses That Don't Exist

A GCP identity with Fleet management roles can grant Kubernetes namespace admin to arbitrary emails — including nonexistent domains — across every cluster in a Fleet scope. Google marked the related finding Won't Fix.

May 22, 2026 Google
Critical 9.6

Google Grants Cluster-Admin to Anyone Who Can Impersonate a Service Account

GKE Fleet registration creates a hidden trust bridge from GCP IAM to Kubernetes RBAC. Anyone with serviceAccountTokenCreator on the Hub SA gets cluster-admin on every registered cluster. Google closed this as Intended Behavior.

May 21, 2026 Google Cloud Pending
Critical 9.9

Microsoft Silently Patched a CVSS 9.9 Privilege Escalation in Azure Backup for AKS

CERT/CC validated a critical privilege escalation in Azure Backup for AKS (VU#284781). Microsoft rejected it, then silently patched it without assigning a CVE or notifying customers.

May 12, 2026 Microsoft None (vendor rejected)
Critical 9.9
